passage.title: Original practice poem 'Low Tide', written for Tarbiyyah Global Academy
paras: The sea has gone out to think.
a crab's cracked armour, a rope
that once held something, a single shoe.
The sand is ribbed like the roof of a mouth.
then a hush that grows into a sound:

questions.q: Write an overview sentence for 'Low Tide'
questions.a: For example: The poet presents the sea as a living mind that leaves and returns by choice.
questions.model: I do: what does the whole poem do? It personifies the sea from start to end: a mind that 'goes out to think' and returns 'having made up its mind'.

questions.q: in the portal response box, write an overview and two analytical paragraphs on how the poet presents the sea
questions.model: Overview | Point: personification | Evidence: 'gone out to think' | Effect: the sea seems thoughtful, not empty | Second paragraph: structure of the return

questions.q: write the third paragraph on the final stanza's structure
questions.a: A paragraph on the build from whisper to sound

questions.q: offer an alternative reading of 'having made up its mind'
questions.a: For example: the return feels deliberate, even slightly threatening
